Our Mission
To facilitate efficient and legally compliant purchasing practices within the City's procurement process by establishing comprehensive purchasing policies and coordinating competitive bids and proposals - all with the purpose of maximizing the effective use of taxpayer dollars.
Our Vison
To be recognized as an ethical, diligent, and integrity-driven department committed to excellence and to being responsible stewards of the taxpayer dollars.
